        rows = [p[0] for p in b]
        cols = [p[1] for p in b]
        print(f"Avatar: rows {min(rows)}-{max(rows)}, cols {min(cols)}-{max(cols)}")

for n in seg['nodes']:
    if n['color'] in ['R', 'b', 'N'] and n['pixels'] == 16:
        b = n['boundary']
        rows = [p[0] for p in b]
        cols = [p[1] for p in b]

            print(f"  {n['color']}: rows {min(rows)}-{max(rows)}, cols {min(cols)}-{max(cols)}")

# Check bridge

for n in seg['nodes']:
    if n['color'] == 'w':
        b = n['boundary']
        cols = [p[1] for p in b]
        bridge_cols.extend(cols)

# Check if any blocks disappeared

for n in seg['nodes']:
    if min([p[0] for p in n['boundary']]) < 50:
        all_colors.add(n['color'])
print(f"  Colors on board: {sorted(all_colors)}")
